head.title: Sitdikov Yaroslav — Middle+ Frontend Developer
head.description: Frontend developer with 3+ years of commercial experience building production web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Experience with performance optimization, testing, SSR and Docker-based environments.

aboutMe.title: Middle+ Frontend Developer
aboutMe.text: Frontend developer with 3+ years of commercial experience building production web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Most recently the lead frontend developer of a Next.js web product for the U.S. apartment rental market: carried out a full site redesign, shipped new features, wrote unit and e2e tests, ran A/B tests and optimized Core Web Vitals. Previously built an e-commerce storefront with Next.js SSR and MobX. Experienced with Docker-based environments; basic knowledge of Node.js/NestJS and Go.

info.title: Frontend
info.text: React, Next.js (SSR / SSG / ISR), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), MobX, REST API, HTML/CSS (SCSS, BEM), Ant Design, MUI

info.title: Performance & Testing
info.text: Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS), Unit Testing, E2E Testing (Playwright), A/B Testing

info.title: Tools
info.text: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Docker, Docker Compose, basic CI/CD

info.title: June Homes
list: Lead frontend developer of a production web product (Next.js, TypeScript) for the U.S. apartment rental market; owned the frontend direction and day-to-day development
Carried out a full redesign of the website: implemented Figma designs by reworking markup, components and application logic
Discussed UI/UX decisions with the designer to agree on the best approach for the redesign
Tested the redesign with Playwright and identified mismatches with the designs
Designed and implemented new user-facing features and maintained the existing frontend
Optimized high-traffic pages with a focus on Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS)
Implemented and maintained A/B tests, unit tests and e2e tests
Worked with backend engineers on integrations, technical improvements and release planning
Maintained application configuration; improved Docker builds and frontend environments
achievements: Improved performance of key pages and reduced CLS by approximately 20%

info.title: Almurut Store
list: Developed the frontend of an e-commerce store with React, TypeScript and Next.js
Used Next.js SSR for server-rendered pages with SEO in mind
Implemented forms, filters, product cards and product pages with Ant Design
Managed application state with MobX; typed complex data structures and components in TypeScript
Set up development environments with Docker and Docker Compose

info.title: Kurut-IT
list: Developed single-page applications with React + Vite
Built responsive, cross-browser layouts from Figma designs (SCSS, BEM, MUI, Bootstrap)
Integrated REST APIs and handled application state and errors
Took part in feature planning and UX discussions
